run.finalText:
I built the lower third as a 6 s piece on a 1920×1080, 30 fps comp. The pieces are **Lower third panel**, **Accent line**, **Name** ("Dr. Amelia Hart") and **Title** ("Head of Research, Larkspur Labs").

- **Accent line:** a thin blue-grey bar grows from its top edge between 0.25 s and 1.2 s.
- **Panel:** a translucent slate panel fades in and slides about 40 px right, 0.1 s to 1.0 s.
- **Name and title:** they rise about 16 px and fade in, staggered from 0.5 s and 0.75 s, on Quart In Out.
- **Hold:** the full lockup holds from about 1.7 s to 4.2 s.
- **Exit:** the text fades first (4.2 s to 4.9 s), then the panel fades and slides back left and the accent line retracts, finishing by 5.5 s. Nothing is left visible at the end.

Everything uses long ease-in-outs with no overshoot. The palette is blue-grey (`#5a6e82` panel at about 70% opacity, `#9db4c8` accent, near-white name, `#b4c1cf` title) on a dark slate background `#141b23`. I used that background as a placeholder so the panel reads; swap in your interview footage and the lower third will sit over it.

I moved the lockup inside the title-safe margin. The only remaining checker notes are the intentional thin accent line and its overlap with the panel.

I haven't reviewed it in motion beyond the contact sheet, so a quick playback is worth doing. Possible next tweaks: a slightly longer hold, a subtle mask wipe on the text instead of the fade, or a second variant with the panel on the right.

items.text: hold in the middle (≥1.5s without key motion)
